tradeoffs.loses: non-OpenAI-backed LiteLLM models (Anthropic, Cohere, etc. selected via USE_LITELLM=true) still bypass Router: install_litellm() only installs the shared httpx session LiteLLM uses for its OpenAI-SDK calls, so only OpenAI-model traffic on this optional path is covered
tradeoffs.why: USE_LITELLM=true is an alternate, non-default production path (default is the already-migrated OpenAI client branch). router_runtime ships install_litellm() specifically to hook LiteLLM's shared client_session with the same translating transport proven in PR1; litellm is an optional extra not installed in this environment so no dynamic probe could be run, but the hook reuses the identical http_client() transport already confirmed to route requests to Router.
